correctness.rationale: The union \(\Delta(A)\cup u*\operatorname{skel}_{r-2}\Delta(A)\) computes the star wedge (including \(r=1\) and contractible high thresholds). Removing the bare middle hub yields a join of two star complexes. Including it yields precisely the double-star higher-independence link at threshold \(r-1\); the published two-hub theorem determines that link. Its attaching map factors through the join of the successive star-threshold inclusions, which are null by connectivity; hence the deletion-link homotopy pushout splits integrally into the two specified sphere wedges. All quantifiers and zero-binomial boundaries have been checked; independent exact mod-two boundary computations agree for 128 finite triples.
